name: Indigo Plateau Tier 5 Level 100 League
summary: Ascend Route 23 to challenge the ultimate difficulty tier at the Indigo Plateau. Tier 4 (Levels 91 to 99) and Tier 5 (Flat Level 100) elevate the Elite Four and Champion Blue to peak competitive mastery. Lorelei commands relentless Blizzard hail offense, Bruno deploys crushing Fighting wallbreakers, Agatha harnesses tricky Ghost/Dark status traps, and Lance commands devastating multiscale Dragon sweepers. Finally, face Champion Blue in a climactic Level 100 full 6 vs 6 showdown. Triumphing over Tier 5 earns the Master Ribbon and seals your legacy as Supreme Pokémon Master.

items.name: Master Ribbon
items.method: Awarded to your active party upon conquering the Tier 5 Level 100 Elite Four and Champion

items.name: Golden Bottle Cap
items.method: Awarded by the League President in the Indigo Plateau lobby post-Tier 5 victory
